notes: The supplied *she* stands in a verbless clause that writes no subject morpheme, so it is added under rule 20; giving it to תֶאֱרֹב as that verb's subject pronoun under rule 17, discontinuous across the whole verse, was the competing reading.
רְחֹבוֹת heads on *broad* by rule 31's subtraction, *places* alone being any place; תֶאֱרֹב heads on *wait* as a light verb plus complement (rule 44).
כֹּל standing on the noun is itself what *every* renders (rule 15).
